description: Only when the user asks: make a public, read-only page for a finished call (result and transcript) that they can send or post. The user's name, phone numbers and emails are always hidden; the business name is hidden unless show_business=true. public=false turns an existing link off.

show_business.description: Show the business's name on the page (default: hidden)

name: share_call
title: Share a call
